DemoIQ

Confirm your tenant details and demo users, then save the config — the skill picks the industry, scenario, personas and content, generates the script, and Copilot writes the content into Outlook and Teams automatically · Internal CSA Tool

💡 How this tool works

🔐
1. Set up credentials (one-time)
Run the app registration script once to create a certificate-based app in your tenant — no client secrets needed. Enter your Admin UPN, App ID, and Certificate Thumbprint. Demo user UPNs auto-populate from the admin domain.

Creates a certificate-based app registration in Entra ID with delegated and application permissions, plus an Azure Speech Services resource for meeting audio synthesis. Paste the App ID, Certificate Thumbprint, and Speech Resource ID it prints into the Tenant Pre-Configuration fields.
🏢
2. Pick an industry and scenarios
Choose from 19 industries with 4 pre-built scenarios each (76 total). These shape everything — emails, chats, channels, files, meetings, and the presenter guide will all be tailored to that customer context.
✨
3. Choose what to create
Tick the content types you want seeded: 📧 Emails, 💬 Teams Chats, 📢 Teams Channel, 📅 Teams Meetings, 📝 Word, 📊 PowerPoint, 📈 Excel, 🎯 Art of Possible Demo Talk Track.
🤖
4. Two ways to generate content
Automatic: the script calls the M365 Copilot API directly.
Manual: check "Paste Copilot responses manually" to copy prompts into Copilot Chat and paste responses back.
📥
5. Save config, download, and run
Save your credentials to an AES-256-GCM encrypted config file. Download the script, unblock it and run it in PowerShell — it authenticates silently via certificate and seeds everything.
🔊
6. Optional: Generate meeting audio
Connect to Azure Speech Service to synthesize realistic multi-voice meeting recordings. Each demo user gets a unique Azure Neural voice.
🔐 Certificate auth: uses a self-signed certificate — nothing sensitive is embedded in the script.

💾 Encrypted config: AES-256-GCM encryption with 200k PBKDF2 iterations. Industry and scenarios are not saved — pick them fresh for each customer.

♻️ Reusable infrastructure: Teams teams, channels, and MFA exclusion groups are reused across runs.

🔒 MFA handling: the script temporarily exempts demo users from MFA so it can post content as each of them.

⚙️ FFmpeg Install (one-time run required)
First time only: install FFmpeg on this machine so the RTMP streaming step below can push the MP3 into a live Teams meeting.
On Windows the easiest way is via winget. Run the command below in PowerShell, then restart your terminal and verify with ffmpeg -version.
winget install --id Gyan.FFmpeg -e --source winget

How to Run This Script

Open PowerShell, allow the script if needed, then run it from your Downloads folder.

1
Open PowerShell 7 as Administrator.
2
Set execution policy if needed:
Set-ExecutionPolicy -Scope CurrentUser -ExecutionPolicy Bypass
3
Navigate to Downloads:
cd "$env:USERPROFILE\Downloads"
4
Run the script:
.\DemoIQ.ps1
5
A browser sign-in window opens — sign in as Global Admin and complete MFA.
6
Watch the terminal — each step prints a coloured status line. The full run takes a few minutes.
7
First run: copy the App ID and Secret the terminal prints and paste them into the 🔗 App Registration section for faster future runs.

✨ What each content type does

How DemoIQ generates each type of demo content and how it gets into the tenant.

📧 Emails
Copilot generates threaded email conversations. The script seeds them via Graph API as real Outlook messages between demo users — complete with RE: threading, file references, and realistic back-and-forth.
💬 Teams Chats
Copilot generates group chat conversations. The script seeds them via Graph API into Teams with all demo users as participants. Messages reference each other naturally for a realistic discussion feel.
📢 Teams Channel
Copilot generates channel discussions. The script creates one channel per scenario via Graph API inside a reusable team. Messages are posted by all demo users as a working discussion.
📅 Teams Meetings
Copilot generates meeting invitations. The script creates calendar events via Graph API with Teams meeting links, structured agendas, expected outcomes, and pre-read references — assigned to the right personas as organizers and attendees.
📝 Word / 📊 PowerPoint / 📈 Excel
Copilot generates the document content. The script creates real Office files and uploads them via Graph API to the first demo user's OneDrive, shared with all demo users — ready to open and demo Copilot in Office.
🎯 Art of Possible Demo Talk Track
Copilot writes a structured presenter guide tailored to your scenario. Saved as a .html file next to the script — use it as talking points or a session outline for the customer conversation.
